The [[Mutant Ooze]] is a lone [[ooze]] that will begin running in a circle when [[aggro]]ed. It does not attack or use any skills, so it can be safely soloed if you are after its [[Bonecage Scythe (unique)|Bonecage Scythe]]. Beware the [[Stormcloud Incubus|Stormcloud Incubi]] [[popup|popdown]] nearby and consider bringing a [[speed boost]]. The Incubi will attack and may kill the Mutant Ooze.
